recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the radiology-specific LOINC comment for FHIR-6243 unless the Imaging Integration work group makes a new, narrower decision that supersedes FHIR-11285.
issue_request: FHIR-6243 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Imaging Integration request to provide at least an example binding to LOINC radiology orderables for ImagingStudy.procedure and clarify whether the ambiguous procedure element should instead be tied to the Procedure resource.
initial_application: FHIR-5998 first changed ImagingStudy.procedure from a coded element to Reference(Procedure). FHIR-6243 was then applied in commit d2e4d8176dcfeb1e57198c63a8a0270acb6c5a88 / svn revision 5634 by adding the LOINC radiology orderables guidance as a comment on Procedure.code rather than as a binding on ImagingStudy.procedure.
additional_context: FHIR-11285 later revisited the exact LOINC radiology orderables comment and resolved to remove it because ImagingStudy is not limited to radiology and implementers should choose the appropriate value set for their environment. Later R6 decisions, including FHIR-47666 and FHIR-53025, refined and reaffirmed the current model in which ImagingStudy.procedure is a Reference(Procedure) for performed procedures, with requested procedures represented through ServiceRequest/basedOn.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The latest combined branch has ImagingStudy active in source/fhir.ini, defines ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure), explains requested versus performed procedures in ImagingStudy notes, and intentionally lacks the old LOINC radiology orderables comment.

related_jiras.note: Changed ImagingStudy.procedure to Reference(Procedure), which made FHIR-6243's original binding request a Procedure.code comment instead of a direct ImagingStudy.procedure binding.
Explicitly removed the LOINC radiology orderables comment because ImagingStudy can be used outside radiology.
Refined the R6 detailed description of ImagingStudy.procedure around performed imaging procedures.
Temporarily moved performed-procedure semantics to ImagingStudy.partOf and removed ImagingStudy.procedure; this was later reverted by FHIR-53025.
Restored and clarified ImagingStudy.procedure as the performed Procedure reference now present in current source.
